learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with programming languages they can use in subsequent years of faculty and after graduation in engineering.
Utilize algorithmic methods, concepts, theories, and programs in the design of mechanical systems, technical problems, and scientific research.
Form skills in using investigation and research methods and techniques.
Develop habits of working with computers and specific programs and solving engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: General presentation of the MathCad package; menus
Solving equations and systems of equations
Symbolic and numerical variables, defined elementary functions
Operations with polynomials, substitutions, defined functions, conversions
Derivation, differentiation, and symbolic solving of algebraic equations and systems of equations
Mathcad applications: Calculation of mathematical expressions, use of mathematical constants, mathematical functions
Use of real and complex variables, calculation of the derivative at a point, calculation of the definite integral
Solving equations and systems of equations
Using units of measurement in Mathcad
Maple applications: Symbolic and numerical variables, defined elementary functions
Operations with polynomials, substitutions, defined functions
teaching_methods: Online examples run on computer + projector

assessment_methods.method: Second distributed evaluation (Mathcad and Maple problems)
Presentation of all compiled programs (practical activities)

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of two distributed evaluations for the course component, each needing a minimum grade of 5. The first evaluation contains 4 problems in Mathcad, each worth 2 points, plus 1 point ex officio. The second evaluation contains 4 Mathcad problems and 3 Maple problems, each worth 1 point, plus 3 points ex officio. The final course grade is the algebraic average of these two evaluations. For practical activities, the grade is based on the final presentation and submission of all compiled files. A grade of 5 represents 50% correct answers.
